mechanism: Old design paired two nonadjacent stars with C and tested E/C against preset C. New design selects an actually adjacent vertical heart pair and maps its ordered positions to horizontal E, targeting decoupled position rotation versus symbol orientation. This removes the old false-adjacency premise; neither source star is marked. E appeared historically but is selected from this different rigid-motion hypothesis, not by relabeling an old image.
primary_math_proof: A rigid motion rotating an adjacent vertical pair into a horizontal domino must rotate the entire symbols by +90 or -90 degrees. The two downward source hearts then point sideways; E has two downward hearts. The only pair of identical downward hearts in the source is column4 rows1-2. Other heart adjacency has different relative headings; the row4 pair has a club between. B matches row1 columns2-3 upright star and upright club without rotation. C has no adjacent stars. A would require an upright star with an upright spade immediately to its right after whole-domino rotation; neither star neighborhood supports that orientation (lower star is rotated20degrees). D heart+vertical diamond cannot preserve their headings after rotating the bottom-left horizontal neighboring pair. Thus B alone. All24 unordered source adjacencies can be checked with the frozen symbol poses; a new enumeration audit accompanies this design.
